argv:
# EVERY INPUT THIS FRAME IS CONDITIONED ON IS FETCHED AND SHA-CHECKED
# BEFORE A GPU SECOND IS SPENT -- driver, skeleton AND the IP-Adapter
# reference. Emitted by pipeline/jerry_canon_0821.py.
import hashlib, os, urllib.request
base = "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/olegmalk/banyan-city/main/farm-out/jerry-canon-assets-0821/"
root = r"C:\banyan-farm\b07twofig-r3-0821\src"
want = [("controlnet_plate.py", os.path.join(root, "pipeline"),
         "ece54f687d892d1fb1df17211331919bfcb04faac4fe0ee6aa9b0bb231adcc32"),
        ("jerry-guard-twofig-0821.png", os.path.join(root, "pipeline", "control"),
         "48bf4edd2d394549b9764215fca84c562b9099e0d155ece6e38ea29a349afcb8"),
        ("jerry-canon-sq45-0821.png", os.path.join(root, "pipeline", "control"),
         "066e0457d060960e470c4ebc4f9936284b08e64550be8b89b1881dc7c7899a4c")]
for name, dst, sha in want:
    os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
    with urllib.request.urlopen(base + name, timeout=120) as r:
        blob = r.read()
    got = hashlib.sha256(blob).hexdigest()
    if got != sha:
        print("!! %s fetched with sha %s, expected %s"
              % (name, got, sha))
        raise SystemExit(1)
    with open(os.path.join(dst, name), "wb") as fh:
        fh.write(blob)
    print("staged", name, got, "->", dst)

steps.name: publish
argv:
# The courier pushes from farm-out and from nowhere else.
# The CONDITIONS travel with the frame: a reader scoring whether the
# adapter carried the EAR needs the ear it was shown.
import glob, hashlib, os, shutil
out_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b07twofig-r3-0821/out"
pay_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b07twofig-r3-0821"
ctl_dir = "C:/banyan-farm/b07twofig-r3-0821/src/pipeline/control"
dst = "C:/banyan-farm/courier-box/farm-out/ep2-b07-twofig-r3-0821"
os.makedirs(dst, exist_ok=True)
files = sorted(glob.glob(out_dir + "/ep2-b07-twofig-r3-0821-ipahead.png*")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/prompt.txt")
               + glob.glob(pay_dir + "/negative.txt")
               + glob.glob(ctl_dir + "/jerry-guard-twofig-0821.png")
               + glob.glob(ctl_dir + "/jerry-canon-sq45-0821.png"))
lines = []
for f in files:
    shutil.copy2(f, dst)
    c = os.path.join(dst, os.path.basename(f))
    with open(c, "rb") as fh:
        h = hashlib.sha256(fh.read()).hexdigest()
    lines.append(h + "  " + os.path.basename(f))
with open(os.path.join(dst, "ep2-b07-twofig-r3-0821.sha256"), "w", newline="\n") as fh:
    fh.write("\n".join(sorted(lines)) + "\n")
print("published", len(files), "file(s) + manifest ->", dst)
raise SystemExit(0 if len(files) >= 6 else 1)
